survey: The object is a round wall clock hanging on a flat wall with vertical green stripes, seen almost straight on and turned very slightly about its vertical axis. The orange rim is a smooth ring around the clock. In the enlarged view it is about 795 px wide and 830 px tall, a slightly narrow ellipse, and the ring is about the same thickness all the way round. The white face is set inside the rim and is narrowed by the same amount (about 645 by 680 px), so the rim and face agree on one view. The 12 hour marks and the ring of minute dots are evenly spaced around the face and point to the centre, following the face's shape. The hour, minute and red second hands lie flat on the face and turn on a single round hub in the centre. The soft shadow on the wall to the lower left matches a flat clock hanging close to the wall. The wall stripes stay vertical and agree with the clock's slight turn. No part shows a second viewpoint.
